name: lispan_chem_v3
description: Phase 3b v3: the v2 network (same five chemistry inputs and box, network Z_CC = 0, w_S / d / Z_CC analytic) over a WIDER RATE RANGE, 0.08-3 C (v2: 0.1-1 C), so that two-curve fits can use the fast curves of the literature (current ratio up to 37.5 instead of 10; e.g. Hao 2025 0.1 + 2 C, Chen 2019 0.4 + 2 or 4 A/g, Ma 2026 0.2 + 1 C, and Simanjuntak 0.1 + 1 C with w_S free). Window and evaluation cases from configs/lispan_chem_design_v3.json (403 chemistries x 0.08/0.1/0.2/0.5/1/2/3 C = 2821 FV runs, all reach the cut-off; degree-6 window, 924 coefficients: max 1.6 %, held-out max 4.0 %, window fraction 0.95; 13 evaluation chemistries x 0.1/0.3/1/3 C). Recipe of v2 without residual-based sampling (no benefit in v2) and with the charge-inventory term from step 20 000 instead of 40 000 (v2 runs sat at 30-130 mV until it started); 250 000 steps (wider range; ~0.43 s per step in the sandbox after the window speed-up, so ~30-35 h per run on one Grace core).
